records.note: The author floats making his own online class series a regular thing. Whether the classes recur is his own decision (with the Brooklyn and Beyond Mental Health Group). Also outside the five areas; the word Maybe marks a hedged intention, not a forecast about a third party.

General claim about trial-site behaviour. No sponsor, site, trial, metric or threshold is named. The outcome (sites prioritize consent conversations) is not observable, and the antecedent (if we pay for it) has no defined actor. Close to a truism.

Claim that the public-relations problem of UnitedHealthcare persists. No poll, series, threshold or period is named, so no observable event can be written. The conditional (absent radical changes) has an undefined antecedent.

Claim that recruiting decent people into insurance leadership gets harder. Not observable: no countable set, series or threshold. The clause about more crackpots is a quantifier without a countable set.
Claim about the character of future insurance executives. Personal traits of future hires are not observable; no entity, event, benchmark or threshold can be written.
Stronger restatement of the labor-pool claim. Only the most callous will sign up and bereft of people motivated to balance ethics and profit have no observable benchmark or countable set.
We are going to get less of those now is a quantifier (less) without a countable set or series. The first sentence is normative. Restates the labor-pool claim.

Framed as the belief of UnitedHealthcare, not as the author own expectation. Even read as the author denial, personal consequences for its executives and meaningful consequences for its shareholders name no enforcement action, case, deciding body or threshold; meaningful is a comparative without a benchmark. Ever is not a deadline.

General deterrence principle about the public resorting to murder. Not a regulatory decision, trial outcome, company or market outcome, payer or policy decision, or practice adoption. Also a truism-like conditional with no countable set.
Announcement of the author own out-of-network class on 9 December 2024. Own activity; also outside the five areas.
Announcement of RAMHT SF on 12 January 2025. The author organizes RAMHT (affiliations), so the event is his own organization action.
Prediction that copycat violence after the murder of the UnitedHealthcare CEO will spread. Criminal or political violence is not one of the five areas. More murder also has no countable set.

A dead person cannot testify, so the asserted content is true by definition. The insider-trading prosecution of other UnitedHealth Group executives is presupposed, not forecast; the sentence states no expectation about whether it happens.

Describes, in the conditional mood, how hypothetical litigation costs would flow through the medical loss ratio to allowed profits. A mechanism description inside a republished satirical letter; no future state is asserted as expected. No threshold or series for increased profits either.
Career plan of an unnamed medical student. Not one of the five areas; the person is unnamed, so no resolvable event could be written in any case.
Present-tense description (is now being brought to market by Magnus Medical) in a republished footnote. It reports a current state; no future state is asserted.
Promise of a next session of the author own live class. Own activity; also outside the five areas.
Promise to publish more newsletter writing tomorrow. Own activity; also outside the five areas.

The author answer, as quoted by the guest author, that a Fermata-style neuromodulation clinic can exist in Horry County. The clinic in question (Living Water Mental Health BRAIN Treatment Center) is the author own venture: he is its Medical Director and it is the pilot site of his company Breakthrough6. The words are also secondhand, and the clinic had already opened (November 2024) by the statement date.
Plan for Breakthrough6, the author own company, to plant hundreds of treatment centers, as reported by the guest author. Own-venture commitment; the words are also secondhand.
We are all going to be worse off has no observable benchmark, and the antecedent (if all the healthcare payments collapse) names no event or threshold. Near-truism.

The subject of it might even make it to a patient is research reaching practice through informed readers. No treatment, adoption metric, series, threshold or period can be written. Sooner rather than later is not a deadline.

There is more coming every day is a quantifier without a countable set: no study, sponsor or readout is named. The second clause (we are trying to make it more accessible) is an own-organization (Fermata) intention.
Medical devices will matter in the future is a slogan-level thesis with no entity, event, benchmark or threshold. In the future is not a deadline.

Gonna be hard to blow up and causing a ruckus name no observable event: no bill, order, agency action or market threshold defines blowing up the PBM industry or the resistance of the industry. The 8.8% CAGR is a cited figure, not the author forecast.

Restates the projection of an unnamed chart that antidepressant spending keeps growing. The forecaster names no series, period or threshold, so a quantity event cannot be written on a named series. The projection belongs to the chart source, not to the author.
Getting into a huge fight with health plans about their PBMs names no observable action: no order, rule, suit or bill. Hedged aside inside a recommendation.
Already here and getting better every day is a trend slogan with no metric, series or threshold.

More is coming is a quantifier without a countable set; the listed devices illustrate it. Coming names no outcome type (FDA authorization, payer coverage or clinical availability), so an event cannot be written without inventing one. nVNS already held FDA clearance for migraine at the statement date, so coming cannot mean authorization for every listed item. Coming is not a deadline.
Psychedelic medicines are coming names no drug, regulator, decision or threshold. Slogan; coming is not a deadline.
Expectation of another mass shooting in the United States, in the subtitle of a republished 2022 satire template. Gun violence is not one of the five areas.
Satire-template line about the next shooter buying assault rifles legally despite prior threats. Gun violence is not one of the five areas.
Satire-template line about the next shooter age and use of high-capacity magazines. Gun violence is not one of the five areas.
Fictional NRA statement written as the expected response to the next mass shooting. Gun politics is not one of the five areas; the quote is also evident satire.
Announcement of RAMHT 2025 in San Francisco on 12 January 2025, the author own conference.
The author own newsletter content plan. Own activity; also outside the five areas.
Fermata, the author own clinic (co-founder), will soon offer VNS. Own-organization service launch. Soon is not a deadline.
Schedule of two RAMHT 2025 events (San Francisco on 12 January; Los Angeles during the APA annual meeting). The author organizes RAMHT.

Videra Health product launch (TDetect coming soon) and a demo at RAMHT SF 2025. Videra Health is in the author affiliations (strategic advisor) and RAMHT is his own conference, so both outcomes are decided by the author own organizations. Soon is not a deadline.
Restates the RAMHT SF 2025 announcement (12 January 2025). Own conference.
